applicable_notes.text:
- **Methodology**: test-after
- **Ordering**: implement each layer, then test it.

strategy_volume: Five to eight tests per component.
Unit tests plus integration tests for key boundaries.
Add E2E, performance, or security tests when requirements demand them.
scope_floor: Run the selected tests in CI before merge.
obligations.combination_rule: Apply every selected-strategy obligation and every scope-floor obligation; neither replaces the other, and a targeted scope regression may add the narrowest necessary test type beyond the strategy default.

plan_profile.runner_step: Bootstrap the minimal test runner/configuration and record the exact unit-scoped command.
